issue.title: [bug] sleep_task_scheduler.py capability_gap awareness-note branch writes to wrong knowledge/ path
issue.symptom: Discovered live during 9ar0 (2026-09-16): the existing capability_gap -> awareness-note branch in sleep_task_scheduler.py (_run_codemind_cycle, ~line 1465) uses a RELATIVE path: awareness_path = file_path or "knowledge/awareness/operational/architecture_facts.md". Verified live in gaia-core-candidate: the running process's cwd is /app, and /app/knowledge is a stray, near-empty local directory (only a 'seeds' subdir) — NOT the real mounted knowledge tree, which is bind-mounted at the ABSOLUTE path /knowledge (docker-compose: ../gaia-instance/knowledge:/knowledge). main.py:2244 already does this correctly for the same file (Path(os.environ.get('KNOWLEDGE_DIR', '/knowledge')) / 'awareness' / 'operational' / 'architecture_facts.md'), and self.config.KNOWLEDGE_DIR is already used elsewhere in this same file (e.g. _REVIEW_QUEUE_PATH). This means every capability_gap awareness-note CodeMind has ever proposed to write has likely been silently written into /app/knowledge/awareness/operational/ inside the container's own ephemeral filesystem (auto-created via os.makedirs) rather than the real, persistent, mounted knowledge base — orphaned on container recreate, invisible to anyone browsing the real knowledge/ tree. Fix: change awareness_path's relative default to Path(self.config.KNOWLEDGE_DIR) / 'awareness' / 'operational' / 'architecture_facts.md', matching the convention 9ar0's new _draft_capability_skill uses. Also worth auditing whether any /app/knowledge/awareness/operational/architecture_facts.md content actually accumulated in production containers (would be silently lost on next recreate) before fixing, in case it's worth manually migrating into the real file first.

regression_test.format: pytest functions added by the fix
regression_test.gold:
# candidates/gaia-core/gaia_core/cognition/tests/test_knowledge_path_bits.py
"""bits: capability-gap awareness notes go to the mounted knowledge tree.
Detections carry "knowledge/awareness/…" paths relative to a cwd of /app, so
notes were appended to a stray /app/knowledge/ inside the container."""

from types import SimpleNamespace

from gaia_core.cognition.sleep_task_scheduler import SleepTaskScheduler


def _resolve(path, kdir="/knowledge"):
    fake = SimpleNamespace(config=SimpleNamespace(KNOWLEDGE_DIR=kdir))
    return SleepTaskScheduler._knowledge_path(fake, path)


def test_relative_knowledge_paths_land_under_knowledge_dir():
    assert _resolve("knowledge/awareness/operational/architecture_facts.md") == \
        "/knowledge/awareness/operational/architecture_facts.md"
    assert _resolve("awareness/x.md", "/srv/k") == "/srv/k/awareness/x.md"


def test_absolute_paths_are_kept():
    assert _resolve("/knowledge/awareness/a.md", "/elsewhere") == "/knowledge/awareness/a.md"
